name: FormBuilder
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; client-editable forms recur — intake, applications, surveys — and are usually hardcoded and redeployed for every wording change)
description: Forms a non-developer can define, rendered through the kernel's field components and validated server-side from the same definition. Submissions are stored, exportable, and never trust the client's idea of what the form contained.
